subject: general
question:
Parts of the given sentence have been given as options. One of them may contain a grammatical error. Select the option that has the error. If there is no error, select ‘No error’.

We cannot postpone discussion on this issue although it is urgent.
solution:
```html

The correct answer is 'Option 4' i.e. this part of the sentence has an error.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

• The phrase 'although it is urgent' is incorrect in this context.

• In the given sentence, the correct conjunction to use is 'even though' instead of 'although'.

• Therefore, the correct phrase should be 'even though it is urgent'.

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

Correct sentence: *We cannot postpone discussion on this issue **even though it is urgent***.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• When expressing a contrast between two clauses, use 'even though' to emphasize the contrast.

• **Example:** ***We decided to go for a walk even though it was raining***.

• Use 'although' when the contrast is less emphatic.

• Example: ***Although it was raining, we went for a walk***.

``
